title: A listing shot on a slow demo host keeps its own deadline: a timed-out shot is stopped and names its phase, and the waits fit what is left
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-host/test/capture.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts.
expect: The run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.
A shot that outlives its box rejects with 'shot timed out after <ms>ms while <phase>' and its AbortSignal is aborted; ok and failed shots both carry ms and timings.
With a 10 s deadline no wait before the pictures asks for more than 2000 ms; with a 3 s deadline none runs and a picture still comes back.
Aborting a shot closes its browser context.
evidence: cowork.tracy.site 12/10/2026 after #1262: ja-vogue j6 /index.php/category-2 'shot timed out after 30000ms' at 1440 and 390 on fleet01; the same capture takes 9-11 s from a Mac mini.
fence: The real runCapture and makeShoot over a fake Playwright. Not exercised: Chromium, fleet01's load.
